coverage.residual_risk: The /rate_limit body is observed live in R7, R8, R9 and the 253-127 probe (seq 1). The probe also showed two interleaved core counters: the /rate_limit body and its own x-ratelimit headers read remaining 4851 (reset 1792193189), while the other probe responses' x-ratelimit headers read 4999, 4998, 4997 (reset 1792195729). The drivers read only resources.core.remaining from the /rate_limit body (fresh_preflight, watch_run, ci-pr-proof preflight), so a window's floor check (> 250, else 'GitHub core API budget is at or below 250') uses the body's counter, never a header. If the counter that debits a window's requests is the other one, the floor can read stale; the request caps in the allocation, not this counter, bound the window. Observed again in 253-133 (R11 canary seq 18) and 253-134 (R11 PR seq 1).
